feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. the person in their 50s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The absence of sound, shaped like wings — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Patrick breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — wha

🔥 The fire settles. Vy has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Highbeam Deer — I put it down today." "Its legs lock. White light wells behind its eyes." "It drops its head — the antlers come around in a short, vicious arc." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Desmond breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Joshua says "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Robin has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Cliffhanger — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Joshua says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Aki says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Joshua has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Aki asks "Say that again — slower." Desmond says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Desmond has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Joshua says "Say that again — slower." Brian says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
💛 The Lucky Coin is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
💛 The Mixtape is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
💛 The Unnamed photograph is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)
💛 The Dispatcher's headset is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)

🔥 The fire settles. Somchai has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nostalgia — I put it down today." "The air fills with light — YOUR memories, projected huge. The beam follows your gaze. MOVE." "The reel stutters — outtakes. Embarrassing ones. Close up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Caleb says quietly "We've been walking past those." Brian says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Brian has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "White Noise — I put it down today." "The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved." "You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai asks "And you're still standing." Caleb breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Caleb has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Tick — I put it down today." "It waits. The questing legs wave — the tell." "Adjacent = attached. No dodge. It's ON you." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Adriano mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Joshua asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Aki has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Somchai asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Caleb asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken — you can hear the wind past the edge of the light.

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.

Aki breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
